title: Inverter AC Flare Nut Micro-Leak & Sensor Recalibration
model: Home Split AC Cooling & Gas Leak Troubleshooter
operating_conditions: High ambient temperature (>35°C) or prolonged continuous cooling
summary: Urgent bulletin for flare nut torque relaxation causing low suction pressure (<70 PSI) and false icing detection.

ordered_checks.action: Switch AC to Fan-Only mode for 30 minutes to clear surface frost from evaporator coil before inspection.
Inspect outdoor service valve flare nuts using neutral soapy solution for bubble formation indicating active gas release.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Do not use open flame or smoke near service ports.

ordered_checks.action: Verify indoor display firmware revision by pressing Sleep button 4 times within 3 seconds.
Halt procedure: Certified HVAC Technician must connect manifold gauge, re-torque brass flare nuts to 18 Nm, and verify R32 suction pressure at 125 PSI.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: MANDATORY SAFETY HALT: Pressurized R32 flammable refrigerant handling requires EPA Universal Certification.

title: Front-Load Washer Inverter Motor Tachometer Calibration & Drain Interlock
model: Front-Load Washing Machine Motor & Drain Pump Assistant
operating_conditions: Excessive foam or unbalanced drum load during spin cycle
summary: Advisory on intermittent E20/OE drain timeouts caused by detergent oversudsing and debris trap cavitation.

ordered_checks.action: Isolate mains electrical plug and open lower-right service flap to drain standing water via emergency rubber hose into a shallow tray.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Disconnect 230V mains plug before opening coin trap.

ordered_checks.action: Unscrew cylindrical debris filter counter-clockwise; wash out trapped coins, hairpins, and lint sediment under warm water.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Hot water burn hazard if cycle was run above 60°C.

ordered_checks.action: Perform Drum Clean cycle with 500ml white vinegar and no laundry to clear pressure transducer tube of residual suds film.
Halt procedure: Authorized Service Specialist must test drain pump motor winding resistance (must read 160-180 Ohms) and inspect impeller triac on main PCB.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: MANDATORY SAFETY HALT: 230V live electrical circuit testing requires certified technician.

title: Smart Inverter Microwave Waveguide Mica Arc Protection
operating_conditions: Sparking, crackling sound, or burnt odor inside heating cavity
summary: Critical safety bulletin: Food splatter carbonization on mica waveguide plate causing high-voltage RF flashover.

ordered_checks.action: Immediately unplug power cord from wall outlet and do not operate microwave oven.
Inspect mica waveguide cover plate on right interior wall of cavity for black carbon burn spots, holes, or oil coating.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Ensure oven interior has cooled down completely.

ordered_checks.action: If mica plate is lightly soiled with food grease without burn marks, clean gently with warm damp microfiber cloth and allow 2 hours to dry.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Do not scrub with abrasive pads.

ordered_checks.action: Halt procedure: Certified Electronics Technician must discharge 4,000V high-voltage capacitor using 20k bleeder resistor probe before servicing magnetron antenna.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: CRITICAL LETHAL VOLTAGE: High-voltage capacitor retains 4,000V DC even after unplugging.

title: French Door Refrigerator Evaporator Drain Line De-icing & Heater Firmware Update
operating_conditions: High ambient humidity (>70% RH) or frequent door openings
summary: Service bulletin addressing condensate drain trough freezing, resulting in sheet ice under vegetable crisper drawers.

ordered_checks.action: Remove lower crisper glass drawers and inspect defrost drain hole trough at rear bottom of fresh food compartment.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Handle glass crisper shelves with care.

ordered_checks.action: Flush drain hole with hot water (60°C) using a turkey baster or silicone syringe until water flows freely into rear compressor drain pan.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Do not use boiling water or sharp metal screwdrivers.

ordered_checks.action: Halt procedure: Certified Refrigerator Technician must install extended copper heat-sink drain clip to defrost element and update controller firmware.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: MANDATORY SAFETY HALT: Evaporator panel disassembly exposes sealed refrigeration lines and 230V defrost heater.
